title: Named-resource synthetic DWG receipt strict-output regression
scope: Align generated named-resource controls with strict DWG read-completeness admission; do not let a receipt synthesized from a DXF import stand in for a physical DWG read.

findings.priorFailure: The fast named-resource import test expected strict typed DWG output from synthetic receipts attached to models parsed from generated DXF. The exporter correctly rejected these incomplete DWG read dispositions; the CTest expectation was stale.
correctedControls: DICTIONARYVAR synthetic typed route: strict-complete output refusal and destination preservation
SCALE synthetic typed route: strict-complete output refusal and destination preservation
MLEADERSTYLE synthetic typed route: strict-complete output refusal and destination preservation
findings.mlineGroup2: The generated MLINE control now expects atomic refusal after mutating redundant group 2. Autodesk documents group 2 as redundant text and identifies group 340 as the MLINESTYLE object reference; this control does not authorize rewriting group 2 from group 340.

authority.relevantRule: MLINE group 2 is the style-name string; group 340 identifies the MLINESTYLE object. Autodesk describes group 2 as redundant and advises against modifying it.

validation.fixturePolicy: Generated DXF controls remain temporary test output. No DWG/DXF fixture files were added.

decision: Keep strict-complete DWG output admission unchanged. A synthetic named-resource receipt does not establish a complete DWG read or support claim. Physical-source routes remain governed by their existing source-bound checks.
